unit.unitinstructions:
⚖ Delphic Maxims

This tutor covers all 147 Delphic Maxims, the short sayings associated with Delphi and ancient Greek moral thought.

  • What you will do: Each prompt shows a maxim number, and you type the matching maxim text in full.
  • Timing: Study screens last about 16 seconds, drill screens about 8 seconds, review screens about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations last about 0.75 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback helps you correct wording quickly, while adaptive spacing keeps difficult maxims circulating until they become stable.
  • Why it helps: The lesson builds precise verbal recall while also reinforcing themes such as self-knowledge, restraint, duty, and character.

Type each maxim as accurately as you can, then begin when you are ready.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .443) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
